protocol.scope: formal PEP/MDEP joint statistics with native-space separation

protocol.primary_inference_unit: dataset mean over outer folds and optimization seeds
protocol.primary_tests: Friedman omnibus across dataset means; paired two-sided Wilcoxon candidate versus NSGA-II; Holm correction across three candidate comparisons within each metric
protocol.within_dataset_view: secondary repeated-run diagnostic; optimizer seeds are nested within outer folds
protocol.pooled_view: descriptive support only; no pooled inferential p-values
protocol.comparison_direction: W/T/L and positive improvement are always candidate relative to NSGA-II

protocol.reference: exhaustive exact native Pareto front for the same outer fold
protocol.inference_note: native metrics are effect summaries relative to an exact reference; no PEP-vs-MDEP significance test is performed across different objective spaces
